entities.summary: Political entities that extended authority over vast territories, diverse populations, and multiple ecological zones. From the Akkadians and Achaemenids through the Maurya, Han, Umayyad, and Qing realms, these sprawling polities developed sophisticated administrative infrastructures — provincial systems, postal networks, standardized weights — that enabled governance at continental scale.
